title: Planning run test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized planning-run reducer test without weakening its behavioral proof. Deliverable: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts owns deterministic hashes/witness/state/command/error helpers; planning-run-reducer.test.ts retains creation, readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization coverage; new planning-run-authority.test.ts owns approval, activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive lifecycle coverage. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6 and the stable planning-contract.js facade. NOT in scope: production edits, new behavior, renamed/skipped cases, or reduced assertions. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Every existing planning-run test case and assertion is preserved exactly once across the two test files; no skip/only/todo or assertion loosening is introduced.
The shared fixture module contains only deterministic test construction/assertion helpers and exports no production API.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and test ordering does not create shared mutable state.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0 with production files unchanged.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

implementationPlan.description: Characterize the exact pre-split proof without editing or running a gate. Confirm prerequisite task-866713137aee4794a51973fe4e6e3f44 is DONE, the 514-line source and three owned paths are clean, and the committed baseline contains exactly 32 `it()` names. Inventory the contiguous helper region and the 20/12 describe-block partition, including all derived loops/matrices, imports, and helper consumers. Use the committed `bcdc2f6` file as the no-loss/no-rename oracle; create no scratch or generated evidence file.

Create `planning-run-test-fixtures.ts` by moving the deterministic helper region verbatim: hash constants and witness values, `summaries`, `finalizeWitness`, `SEALED`, `state`, `commandFor`, `expectError`, `expectIllegal`, and `accepted`. Export only symbols consumed by the two test files; use type-only imports from the stable `planning-contract.js` facade and keep Vitest `expect` solely for the moved assertion helpers. Do not change object shapes, literals, error expectations, casts, or factory behavior; introduce no module-level `let`, random/time source, production re-export, or test registration. Keep the fixture <=250 physical lines.

Split describe blocks by verbatim move. Keep the 20 creation/readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization cases in `planning-run-reducer.test.ts`; move the 12 approval/activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive lifecycle cases into new `planning-run-authority.test.ts`, together with their required `RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES`/reducer-constant imports. Both tests import shared helpers through `./planning-run-test-fixtures.js`. Preserve every `describe`/`it` name, assertion body, loop-derived matrix, ordering within each block, and exact error/result expectation; add no skip/only/todo and no cross-file mutable writes. Keep all three owned files <=250 lines.

Run the single exact regression gate once after the complete split: `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test`. Require exit 0 and retain the fresh command, exit code, and output tail for `moe.complete_task`. Any failure is a move/import defect in the three owned test paths; production files and assertions remain off-limits.

Perform the one final adversarial review. Mechanically compare the combined post-split `it()` name multiset with all 32 committed baseline names and diff every moved helper/describe body against `bcdc2f6` to prove each appears exactly once with no rename/assertion/loop drift; scan for skip/only/todo, module-level `let`, writes to imported fixture values, nondeterministic APIs, or package-root exports. Use an in-memory cross-platform Node counter to prove each owned file is <=250 under LF/CRLF/CR, confirm production/index/other tests are untouched, and run `git diff --check`. If review causes any edit, rerun the exact gate. Then inspect shared `git status --porcelain`, stage/commit only the three explicit owned paths (never broad add or bare commit), and verify `git show --stat` lists exactly those paths.

reopenReason: Human explicitly requested PLAN; promoting the next ordered planning test decomposition child.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Use the task's existing describe-boundary split: the original file keeps the first 20 creation/readiness/ownership/submission/finalization cases; the new authority file receives the final 12 approval/activation/cancellation/concurrency/version/matrix cases; a shared fixture module receives the contiguous helper region. Rejected a three-test-file split because three files already land comfortably below 250 and the authority/concurrency matrix is one coherent responsibility. Rejected fixture rewrites, new assertions, or runtime freezing changes because this is a verbatim test decomposition. Rejected the prior plan's baseline gate, two isolation gates, full-repo gate, and repeated package run: current moe-planning requires one concentrated exact gate at task end.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The stable planning-contract facade prerequisite task-866713137aee4794a51973fe4e6e3f44 is DONE. planning-run-reducer.test.ts is 514 physical lines with exactly 32 named `it()` cases. Lines 18-153 are a clean shared-fixture responsibility: deterministic hash/witness constants, `summaries`, `finalizeWitness`, `SEALED`, `state`, `commandFor`, and exact rejection/acceptance assertion helpers. Lines 155-361 contain 20 cases in creation/readiness, ownership, submission, and finalization describes; lines 362-514 contain 12 authority/cancellation/concurrency cases. The fixture imports Vitest `expect` only for test assertion helpers and is not collected as a suite because it is not a `.test.ts` file.
planningNotes.risks: The primary hazards are losing, duplicating, renaming, or subtly editing an assertion while moving; separating a derived matrix from its production constants; or introducing shared writes through a fixture module cache. Preserve all 32 names/bodies exactly once, move entire describe blocks, keep `RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES`/transition constants with the authority file that uses them, and keep every fixture binding const with no module-level `let` or writes from tests. Do not add skip/only/todo, export fixtures through package root, touch production sources, or use Unix-only line-count commands. Shared-tree commit must name only the three owned paths.
